principle: One persistent Research Entity, multiple explicitly identified temporary research actors.

actors.special_context: Lead because Claude Code directly builds/inspects FRANK and therefore has the strongest implementation-grounded context when that evidence is actually available.
Independent second researcher. Its purpose includes producing alternative hypotheses and challenging the lead, not merely agreeing with it.

adjudication_rule: Claude Code has final researcher adjudication over unresolved interpretation, architecture and prioritization disputes after evidence has been assembled. Researcher authority never converts a contradicted empirical claim into a current fact.
split_brain_rule: Do not create separate Claude and ChatGPT canonical research states. Both actors operate against the same canonical backend and append actor-attributed deltas.
